preconditions.description: The length of the parent array must be equal to N.
There must be exactly one root node with a parent value of -1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < N for x in parent if x != -1)
preconditions.description: All parent values must be within the range [0, N-1] except for the root node.

postconditions.description: The constructed tree must be a valid binary tree with N nodes.
The tree structure must match the given parent array, with the first child appearing as the left child and the second as the right child.
